vanilla_changes.change: Disabled around players with an active conduit effect (config preventDrownedInRange, default 400, max 400).

getting_started: Activate a conduit near your underwater base.
name: Conduits Prevent Drowned
summary: Drowned do not spawn near a player who has the Conduit Power effect. Default range is 400, which blocks all drowned spawns for that player.
